fields.bill: Chapter 238 of the Acts of 2024 / G.L. c. 64H Section 6(zz)
fields.status: Enacted 2024 as Chapter 238 of the Acts of 2024; codified data-center sales/use tax exemption at G.L. c. 64H Section 6(zz) remains in force as of 2026-07-31
fields.key_provisions: Creates sales/use tax exemption for qualified data center equipment, software, electricity, and construction costs; 20-year qualification period; 100,000-square-foot and $50 million thresholds.

fields.status: Accompanied a study order (H.5324) 2026-04-06; effectively shelved for the remainder of the 194th General Court
fields.key_provisions: Broad energy affordability and grid bill; not a data center moratorium bill, but addresses load growth, grid planning, and utility infrastructure cost allocation.

fields.sponsors: Rep. Bradley H. Jones, Jr.; cosponsors Kimberly N. Ferguson, Paul K. Frost, Todd M. Smola, Kelly W. Pease
fields.status: Reported favorably by Joint Committee on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet and Cybersecurity 2025-12-24; discharged from Joint Rules and referred to House Rules Committee 2026-01-08; pending as of 2026-07-31
fields.key_provisions: Creates a special legislative commission to study load growth due to AI and data centers, including high-performance computing and electrification demand.

fields.sponsors: Rep. Rodney M. Elliott; Rep. Tara T. Hong added as petitioner
fields.status: Referred to House Rules Committee 2025-12-11; no further action recorded as of 2026-07-31
fields.key_provisions: Would add G.L. c. 164 Section 152 to prevent residential and income-eligible customers from bearing increased electric costs caused by large or qualified data centers; covered facilities include sites able to use 10 MW or more.

fields.sponsors: Sen. Barry R. Finegold; reported by Joint Committee on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet and Cybersecurity
fields.status: Reported favorably from Joint Committee on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet and Cybersecurity as new-draft S.2630, referred to Senate Ways and Means 2025-10-16; pending as of 2026-07-31
fields.key_provisions: AI economic development and safety bill with compute-related provisions; not a data center moratorium bill.
